POSITION SUMMARY INFORMATION: DUTIES AND REQUIREMENTS

Job Summary:

The Armed Security Guard is responsible for providing essential, high-level armed security services at an assigned U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Service (USCIS) government facility. This role involves maintaining a visible presence, controlling access, screening visitors, and responding to incidents in strict compliance with federal contract requirements and Agency Security Classification (ASC) procedures. Guards work on-site, typically as part of a two-person team.

Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Perform continuous access control duties, including screening visitors and personnel using walk-through magnetometers and hand-held detection wands.
  • Conduct regular facility checks, monitor surveillance systems, and ensure the overall security and integrity of the assigned USCIS site.
  • Respond promptly and appropriately to all security incidents, emergencies, and alarms according to established post orders and emergency response plans.
  • Accurately and thoroughly document all activities, incidents, and security breaches in daily and incident reports.
  • Provide professional and courteous service while enforcing security protocols for all agency personnel and visitors.
  • Maintain proficiency in the proper setup, calibration, and operation of all assigned security equipment, including screening devices.
  • Ensure personal compliance with all federal, state, and local regulations, and all site-specific Post Orders.
  • Work effectively with the assigned partner guard and communicate clearly with the designated Regional Security Manager regarding any operational or personnel issues.

Required Education, Certifications, Licenses, and Experience:

  • Must be a U.S. citizen.
  • Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English proficiently.
  • Must have minimum of two (2) years of armed, relevant security experience from a military, law enforcement, or commercial armed guard background.
  • Must legally own and possess a registered approved 9mm semiautomatic pistol or .45 ACP handgun.
  • Must possess and maintain an active State Security Guard License for the state of the assigned post.
  • Must possess and maintain an active State Firearms License (or equivalent permit/qualification) for the state of the assigned post.
  • Must maintain current firearm qualifications, first-aid/CPR certifications, and complete annual use-of-force training and de-escalation training consistent with federal, state, and local requirements.
  • Demonstrated experience in the operation, calibration, and maintenance of walk-through metal detectors (magnetometers) and hand-held detection wands.
  • Must be able to stand and patrol for extended periods and perform duties requiring physical exertion in response to security incidents.
  • Must successfully complete USCIS Office of Security and Integrity (OSI) suitability screening and background checks prior to assignment.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills for reporting and interaction with the public.
  • Must possess a valid driver's license and reliable transportation to the assigned site.

Work Environment:

Employees may be exposed to extreme cold or hot weather conditions, fumes, or airborne particles, toxic or caustic chemicals, and loud noise.

Physical Requirements:

Employees may be required to remain in a stationary position, stand, push, pull, climb, kneel, crawl, balance, squat, bend, and reach during shifts. Employees may be also required to use gear to move items around, including, but not limited to, carts and dollies. Employees may also be occasionally required to lift and/or move up to 49 pounds.

GardaWorld Federal Services is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Security Officer (Full-Time)
jobs.description:
Organization- Hyatt Regency Hill Country Resort and Spa

Summary

Schedule Requirements: Must be available to work a flexible schedule during the week, including weekends and holidays.

Role

The Security Officer is responsible for the oversight of the safety and security of the hotel guests and employees. This person will follow safety and security standards and complete incident reports as required.

Key Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Ensure the overall safety and security of the hotel guests, Colleagues and hotel premises
  • Act as a member of the Emergency Response Team, responding in cases of fire, accident, safety concerns and calls for medical assistance
  • Investigate and report any violations to law or hotel policy
  • Provide First Aid and C.P.R. as required
  • Conduct regular floor patrols, cash counts and crowd control
  • Maintain computer records of all actions in a Daily Activity Report
  • Assist guests regarding hotel facilities in an informative and helpful way

About Our Resort

Nestled across 300 scenic acres in the heart of Texas Hill Country, Hyatt Regency Hill Country Resort & Villas is San Antonio's premier luxury resort destination, where authentic Texas hospitality meets world-class amenities and unforgettable experiences.

Fresh off a multi-million-dollar transformation, our award-winning resort features beautifully redesigned guest rooms, an expanded collection of luxury villas, enhanced dining experiences, revitalized meeting and event spaces, and exciting new recreation offerings designed to elevate every guest stay.

Guests can unwind at our full-service Windflower Spa, enjoy 27 holes of championship golf, float along our signature lazy river, and experience the perfect blend of relaxation and adventure that has made us a leading destination for leisure travelers, corporate groups, weddings, and special events. Our unique event venues include the stunning Rancher Hall Event Barn, offering an authentic Texas backdrop for memorable celebrations and gatherings.

Recognized as the #1 Resort in San Antonio by TripAdvisor and consistently ranked among the top resorts in Texas, Hyatt Regency Hill Country Resort & Villas continues to set the standard for exceptional guest experiences.

As we enter an exciting new era of growth, innovation, and elevated luxury, we are seeking passionate hospitality professionals who are inspired to lead, create meaningful connections, and help shape the future of one of Texas' most celebrated resort destinations. Here, you'll find more than a career—you'll find opportunities to grow, develop, and make a lasting impact while working alongside a team that truly cares for one another and our guests.

Why Join Us?

At Hyatt, we prioritize creating a culture where colleagues feel like family. Since 1957, we've grown into one of the world's leading hospitality brands by valuing our people. We transform jobs into fulfilling careers, turning guest stays into unforgettable journeys, and fostering an environment where belonging and care thrive.

Qualifications

  • A true desire to satisfy the needs of others in a fast paced environment
  • Refined verbal and written communication skills to provide guests and colleagues elevated service
  • Ability to stand for long periods of time and walk moderate distances
  • Must be able to work a flexible schedule, including weekends and holidays
  • Proficient in basic computer skills
  • Previous security experience preferred

Benefits & Perks

  • Health, dental and vision benefits
  • Discounted & complimentary hotel room nights
  • Paid time off
  • Retirement savings plan
  • Employee stock option plan
  • Enjoy complimentary meals in our colleague café
  • Tuition reimbursement, up to $1,000 a year
  • Excellent training and professional development
  • Opportunities to work around the world with Hyatt Hotels and Resorts

About The Hiring Process

We are excited that you have chosen to express interest in joining Hyatt Hotels and Resorts. We will be sure to take a look at your application and get back to you within a week of your submission. Thank you for your patience while we do so.

All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

Proof of eligibility to work in the United States is required, as well as a completed background check.

jobs.description:
Join a Global Leader in Aviation Security!

$17.00 per hour

Medical, dental & vision insurance available! 401K with company matching! Paid vacation & holidays!

ACTS-Aviation Security Inc. has an immediate opening for an Aviation Security Agent at the San Antonio Airport in San Antonio, TX to carry out aviation security functions as prescribed by Transportation Security Administration rules and regulations.

Established in 2001, ACTS-Aviation Security has grown to become one of the leading providers of security solutions to the US aviation market. ACTS-Aviation Security, Inc. is a wholly owned subsidiary of the international aviation security company ICTS Europe and specializes in the provision of aviation-related security solutions and services; primarily focused on catering inspection. With corporate office in Chicago, and operational centers at more than 30 airports across the United States, ACTS provides nationwide coverage. As an ICTS Europe subsidiary, ACTS offers unmatched experience, expertise, quality and innovation. ACTS Aviation Security Agents are proud of their role in aviation security and have the opportunity for advancement – the ideal place to build a career in aviation security.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Inspects airline catering equipment and checks for any unauthorized items in accordance with Transportation Security Administration security rules and regulations.
  • May be required to perform aircraft monitoring according to airline carrier security specifications.
  • Performs all other duties as assigned by management.
  • Reports to Operations Supervisor or Operations Manager, depending on size of unit.
  • Activities overseen by Lead or Senior Lead, depending on size of unit.

Education:

High school diploma or GED

Requirements:

  • New employees are required to complete an FBI Criminal History Records Check (SIDA Badge) and a confirmed 10-year background check (10 year listed; 5 year verified)
  • Not have been convicted of any of the listed FAA/TSA Disqualifying Crimes;
  • Ability to bend, push, and lift up to 30 pounds on a regular basis in order to perform the essential functions of the job.
  • Must be at least 18 years old.
  • Hold a valid U.S. driver’s license
  • Must be willing to work in cold temperatures, as it is a requirement for this role.

Communication Skills:

Proficient written and oral communication skills in English.

Certificates, Licenses and Registrations:

None.

Travel:

None

Environmental Requirements:

Works non standard work hours, evenings, weekends, holidays.

Demonstrated Competencies to be Successful in the Position:

  • Security Mindset – take pride in keeping the skies safe and the flights secure
  • Trust - keeping promises and speaking the truth.
  • Customer Focused - the willingness to listen and the duty to act – promptly and appropriately.
  • Team Spirit - integrity, experience, collaboration and open communication.
  • Innovation – creativity, seeking new ideas, continuous improvement though anticipating change and adapting to it.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. Management reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary. In addition, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

Candidates will be required to go through pre-employment drug screen, criminal check and/or airport fingerprinting.

ACTS is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
